Transit Handling Incident Report

Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk completed the handling and moved the traveler and animal through the remaining steps with close supervision.

During outward check-in, the traveler presented the pet for carriage and the crate was accepted after routine visual inspection. Staff gave standard guidance on feeding, ventilation, and handover points, and the animal remained calm during transfer to the secure holding area. The issue began when a side latch on the crate shifted during movement at the ramp interface, which caused concern that the enclosure might not remain fully secure. Staff stopped the handoff immediately, isolated the crate, and confirmed that the animal was safe and uninjured. The traveler was informed at once, and the senior coordinator reviewed the condition of the crate before any further movement. <<FACT F120>> The traveler was then advised on the next available steps for continuation, and the animal was kept under watch by trained staff throughout the review.

Handling was controlled without delay. A replacement crate was brought forward, the pet was transferred under direct supervision, and the original crate was removed from service for inspection. The loading path was checked again, the gate team was notified, and the final transfer was completed only after the secure fit was confirmed. The traveler received clear explanation of the situation and the follow-up path for any claim or service review. A short internal note was logged for maintenance attention, and the kennel team was instructed to inspect similar equipment before future use. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will monitor the case through close follow-up and confirm closure after the equipment review is complete.
